scenarios.name: one-instance
scenarios.why: one zECS instance installed (CSDZC##.rdo with @id@ = 01): INQUIRE URIMAP START / NEXT ... browses ZC01, ZC01D, ZC01R; only ZC01 (prefix 'ZC', no suffix) starts its expiration task: START TRANSID('ZX01') FROM(URI-TRAN = 'ZC01') LENGTH(4), WRITEQ TD '@tdq' and WRITE OPERATOR 'zECS start ZX01 for ZC01 /resources/ecs/walmart/cache*'; NEXT past the last is END (RESP2 2), INQUIRE URIMAP END, RETURN

scenarios.name: other-urimaps
scenarios.why: definitions that are not a zECS instance -- another prefix (DFHWEB01, ZD02), a 'ZC' name with a suffix (ZCABX), one with no alias transaction (NOTRAN: TRANSACTION blank) -- start nothing; instance 07 among them starts ZX07

scenarios.name: short-name
scenarios.why: a URIMAP named just 'ZC': URI-PREFIX(3:2) is blank, so START TRANSID('ZX  ') and the message says 'zECS start ZX   for ZC'

scenarios.name: no-urimaps
scenarios.why: no URIMAP installed: the first NEXT is END (RESP2 2), EOF; nothing started; INQUIRE URIMAP END, RETURN

notes: zECS's start-up program (ZECSPLT: a PLTPI program, or transaction ZPLT in Source/CSDZECS.rdo). It browses the URIMAP definitions installed in the region (INQUIRE URIMAP START, NEXT until a condition, END; NOHANDLE throughout) and, for each one named 'ZC' + a two-character instance id with no suffix, STARTs that instance's expiration transaction ZX<id> FROM its alias transaction (LENGTH 4), writes 'zECS start ZX<id> for <transaction> <path>' to TD queue '@tdq' (CSSL is PIC X(4) VALUE '@tdq@': the install's placeholder, truncated) and to the console (WRITE OPERATOR). The installed definitions are a fact of the region, stated per scenario on both sides ("urimaps": the stub's $GGCICS_URIMAPS, CicsTask.withUrimaps; oracle_assumptions.md X32), following zECS's CSD template Source/CSDZC##.rdo (three URIMAPs per instance). The browse order IBM leaves open (X32): every scenario has at most one zECS instance, so nothing compared depends on it. Every transaction is defined (the case states no CSD transactions), so each START is NORMAL; its expiry is the case's clock + 0 (no INTERVAL). Derived from zECS (github.com/walmartlabs/zECS, Apache-2.0): LICENSE here is the corpus's own, NOTICE names the source and what was derived.
